goal: Correct the XD03 domain knowledge model's treatment of multi-result validation and terminal display truth, without changing any original product, code, tests or build.
originalHypothesis: A fail-close adapter and an ALL_PASSED validationSummary necessarily agree, because there is only one check per validation layer.

alternativeApproaches.name: Treat first PASS as sufficient for every repeated layer
alternativeApproaches.reason: Drops later same-layer negative evidence; cannot represent byte constraint failure.

alternativeApproaches.name: Assume contradictory summary means bad bytes passed production Core
alternativeApproaches.reason: Original adapter derives WRONG_TARGET/allApplicableValidationPassed=false and Core checks the guard, so this would be an unwarranted escalation.

alternativeApproaches.name: Model producer checks, all applicable same-layer validation results, aggregation projection, canonical reason and Core consumption as separate Elements
alternativeApproaches.reason: Retains actual fail-close success and isolates the first-match reporting defect with a falsifiable scoped witness.

source.originalProduct: docs/product/PRD-v0.4.1-review-candidate.md is Stage1 review candidate, not frozen Product signoff

observedResult.positive: S3 adapter appends target failed on SHA mismatch, find(!passed) detects it, returns WRONG_TARGET; core S3 checks allApplicableValidationPassed and can record validation failure.
observedResult.negative: Result projection validationSummary performs .find(check.layer===layer), selecting prior target PASS rather than later target FAIL; ALL_PASSED 4/0 can coexist with FAILED + WRONG_TARGET.
observedResult.initialAssumptionFailure: Assuming one result per layer erased contradictory evidence; actual source allows multiple checks for same target layer.
observedResult.correction: Preserve or aggregate ALL same-layer checks; a later FAIL must dominate summary for its applicable layer. This is a DKE proposed invariant, NOT an original runtime patch.
observedResult.runtimeEvidence: R80 Node22.16.0 isolated source-equivalent reproduction, not original adapter/Host Native.

elementSplitCounterexample: Single Element 'validated media' conflates 1) raw per-layer checks 2) aggregate canonical reason 3) terminal human/machine-readable status 4) Core disposition and 5) work-level rights. A valid Core rejection and false ALL_PASSED summary prove these need separately owned and independently falsifiable contracts.
domainModelDelta: R61 adds a local XD03 root/Global, leaf Elements, Bounded Contexts, aggregates and candidate SAP cases that reject contradictory summary without claiming any original software runtime change.
alternativeFailureMechanism: A consumer reading only summary could be misled, but an actual consumer reading allApplicableValidationPassed may remain fail-closed; distinguish observed and hypothetical impacts.
changeAndStaleness: On XD03 producer or projection blob revision, invalidate only dependent XD03 check-aggregation/terminal-summary Element and SAP; do not invalidate PREMIS publisher facts, work-rights Oracle, or 13 other projects without actual source change.
professionalAndRights: PREMIS 3.0 publisher reference is preservation metadata vocabulary, not rightsholder copy license or success of real HTTP transfer; actual content rights and professional Oracle pending.
